stances_toward.note: Treaty ally: the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership Treaty signed in Pyongyang on 19 Jun 2024 and ratified by the Federation Council on 6 Nov 2024 commits each side to military support if the other is attacked, and it has been used - 10,000-12,000 Korean troops in Kursk from late 2024, confirmed by Gerasimov on 26 Apr 2025 and by Pyongyang two days later, 16,000-22,000 by 2026 estimates, a missile brigade in Voronezh (Aug 2026), about 12 million shells by mid-2025, in return for USD 10-14bn and technology. Warming: the first road bridge opened in Sept 2026 and the missile deliveries widened in 2026. This is the alliance Ukraine's card is still missing (BACKLOG). Bond - affinity: Soviet-era patronage renewed, not kinship.
